main.content:
==English==

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|id=designate|:inh|enm:assignen<id:allot>|tree=1}}
{{root|en|ine-pro|*sek-}}
{{root|en|ine-pro|*sekʷ-|id=follow}}
From {{inh|en|enm|assignen}}, from {{der|en|fro|assigner}}, {{m|fro|asigner}}, from {{der|en|la|assignō}}, from {{m|la|ad-}} + {{m|la|signō||mark, sign}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/əˈsaɪn/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-assign.ogg|a=US}}
* {{hyph|en|as|sign}}
* {{rhymes|en|aɪn|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[designate]] or set apart (something) for some [[purpose]].
#: {{co|en|to '''assign''' a day for trial}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[appoint]] or [[select]] (someone) for some [[office]].
#: {{co|en|to '''assign''' counsel for a prisoner}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[allot]] or give (something) as a [[task]].
#: {{syn|en|commission}}
#* {{RQ:Hough Purchase Price|chapter=I|text=Captain Edward Carlisle{{...}}felt a curious sensation of helplessness seize upon him as he met her steady gaze,{{nb...}}; he could not tell what this prisoner might do. He cursed the fate which had '''assigned''' such a duty, cursed especially that fate which forced a gallant soldier to meet so superb a woman as this under handicap so hard.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[attribute]] or [[sort]] (something) into [[categories]].
## {{lb|en|LGBTQ}} To [[categorize]] (someone) as belonging to the [[male]] or [[female]] [[sex]].
# {{lb|en|transitive|legal}} To [[transfer]] ([[property]], a legal right, etc.) from one person to another.
# {{lb|en|transitive|programming}} To give (a value) to a [[variable]].
#: {{ux|en|We '''assign''' 100 to x.}}

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|set apart something for some purpose}} {{l|en|allocate}}, {{l|en|earmark}}; see also [[Thesaurus:set apart]]
* {{sense|transfer property}} {{l|en|consign}}, {{l|en|convey}}; see also [[Thesaurus:transfer]]

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# An [[assignee]].
#* {{RQ:Dickens Christmas Carol|2|Scrooge knew he was dead ? Of course he did. How could it be otherwise ? Scrooge and he were partners for I don’t know how many years. Scrooge was his sole executor, his sole administrator, his sole '''assign,''' his sole residuary legatee, his sole friend and his sole mourner.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} A thing relating or belonging to something else; an [[appurtenance]].
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Hamlet Q1-2|version=Q2|V|ii|passage=The King ſir hath wagerd with him ſix Barbary horſes, againgſt the which hee has impaund as I take it ſix French Rapiers and Poynards, with their '''aſſignes,''' as girdle, hanger and ſo.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} An [[assignment]] or [[appointment]].
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} A [[design]] or [[purpose]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1609|author=[[w:John Ford (dramatist)|John Ford]]|chapter=Fame's Memorial: An Elegy upon the Earl of Devonshire|page=9|pageurl=https://books.google.com/books?id=u8IIAAAAQAAJ&pg=PA9|passage=He aim’d at high designs, and so attain’d / The high '''assigns''' to which his spirit aim’d.}}
